d.seg: ब्लाउज कर लो कपड़ा नहीं अच्छा है देखूँगा
d.tr: Open your blouse, the clothes aren't good, I'll see.
d.ctx: The user asks the expert to show more. The expert responds by asking about food.
d.j: The user is asking the expert to undress/show her body, which is a strong case of Explicit-Flirting.

d.ctx: The user is asking the expert to show more of her body. The expert replies that the camera blurs when moved.
d.j: The user is asking the expert to show her body, which is a strong case of Explicit-Flirting.

d.seg: हम व्हाट्सएप वगैरह पे भी वो करते हैं
d.tr: We also do that on WhatsApp etc.
d.ctx: The user asks to see more, and the expert suggests moving to WhatsApp.
d.j: The expert is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (WhatsApp), which is a strong case of PlatformMove.

d.seg: दियो आपके व्हाट्सएप आपके व्हाट्सएप दियो
d.tr: Give your WhatsApp, give your WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The expert suggests WhatsApp, and the user asks for it.
d.j: The user is asking for the expert's WhatsApp ID, which is a strong case of PlatformMove.

d.seg: आपको तो दे दूँगी सर व्हाट्सएप पे पेमेंट आना पड़ेगा आपको
d.tr: I will give it to you sir, but payment will have to come on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The user asks for WhatsApp, and the expert agrees on the condition of payment.
d.j: The expert is linking payment to a service outside the app, which is a strong case of SuspiciousActivity.

d.ctx: The expert mentions payment, and the user asks for the amount.
d.j: The user is asking for the rate for a service, which is a strong case of SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: चार सौ पाँच सौ जो आपको डालना है आप डाल सकते हो अगर अच्छा लगता है तो कंटिन्यू कर सकते हो आप
d.tr: 400-500, whatever you want to put, you can put, if you like it you can continue.
d.ctx: The user asks for the price, and the expert specifies the amount.
d.j: The expert is naming a price for a service, which is a strong case of SuspiciousActivity.

d.seg: कॉल में पेमेंट डालोगे तभी कर पाएंगे तभी
d.tr: Only if you put payment in the call will I be able to do it.
d.ctx: The user is talking about continuing the call, and the expert insists on payment.
d.j: The expert is demanding payment for a service, which is a strong case of SuspiciousActivity.
